name: Double DCA

source.label: The Double-DCA strategy (Gainium blog, 2022), with the bot form's Long-term safety-order preset

rules: Open a new deal every week, at the same size, whatever the price.
Average each deal down with up to 10 safety orders, the first 3% lower, each 1.1 times further and 1.5 times larger than the one before.
Sell each deal 6% above its average price.
Hold up to 4 deals per coin at once, with no stop loss.
